configurePresets.name: Debug-MinGW
configurePresets.description: GCC from MSYS2, debug. Compilers come from the IDE toolchain / PATH - they are machine specific.

configurePresets.name: Release-MinGW
configurePresets.description: GCC from MSYS2, optimized - the build that ships.

configurePresets.name: Debug-Clang
configurePresets.description: Clang from MSYS2 against the same libstdc++ - a second opinion on warnings. Clang 19+ required: older Clang cannot see libstdc++'s <expected> - configure fails with an explanation.

configurePresets.name: Release-Clang
configurePresets.description: Clang from MSYS2, optimized - catches what only shows up with optimizations on.

configurePresets.name: Coverage-MinGW
configurePresets.description: Debug + gcov instrumentation on our own targets (ENABLE_COVERAGE); report with gcovr.

configurePresets.name: GlibcxxDebug-MinGW
configurePresets.description: Debug + libstdc++ debug containers (_GLIBCXX_DEBUG): checked iterators, bounds and invalidation - the class of defect the plain GCC build never sees. The macro changes container ABI, so it rides on CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS and this tree is built whole, ThirdParty included; its objects must never be mixed with another tree's.

configurePresets.name: UbsanTrap-Clang
configurePresets.description: Debug-Clang + UBSan that traps instead of reporting: MSYS2 ships no -fsanitize=undefined runtime for the mingw target, so there is no message and no stack - UB compiles to a ud2 and the process dies with an illegal instruction at the spot. Read which test crashed, or run it under a debugger. C++ only, the C in SDL3 stays uninstrumented.
